name: Miyaoka Kazuhiko
source:
Public Security Officer — Supervisor of Taiga Agatsuma.
A veteran policeman who leads the Public Security Bureau’s Anti-Terrorism Task Unit. Directs his team while overseeing the investigation into the current terrorist incident.
